{"edits":[{"old":"    gmsh.option.setNumber("Mesh.MeshSizeFromCurvature", 14)","new":"    gmsh.option.setNumber("Mesh.MeshSizeFromCurvature", 28)"},{"old":"    gmsh.option.setNumber("Mesh.ElementOrder", 1)
    gmsh.option.setNumber("Mesh.MshFileVersion", 4.1)
    gmsh.model.mesh.generate(3)
    gmsh.model.mesh.setOrder(2)
    gmsh.write(str(run / "mesh.msh"))","new":"    gmsh.option.setNumber("Mesh.ElementOrder", 1)
    # Keep midside nodes on their straight edges. Projecting them onto CAD
    # inverted several otherwise valid tetrahedra in the previous mesh.
    # Displacement interpolation remains quadratic; finer surface sampling
    # controls the piecewise-planar geometry approximation.
    gmsh.option.setNumber("Mesh.SecondOrderLinear", 1)
    gmsh.option.setNumber("Mesh.MshFileVersion", 4.1)
    gmsh.model.mesh.generate(3)
    gmsh.model.mesh.setOrder(2)
    _, volume_element_tags, _ = gmsh.model.mesh.getElements(3)
    determinants = np.asarray(gmsh.model.mesh.getElementQualities(
        np.concatenate(volume_element_tags), "minDetJac"))
    if not len(determinants) or not np.isfinite(determinants).all() or np.min(determinants) <= 0:
        raise RuntimeError("Nonpositive or invalid tetrahedral Jacobian before solver export")
    log("Straight-sided quadratic mesh: minimum Jacobian determinant %.12g mm^3; curvature sampling 28 elements per full circle"
        % np.min(determinants))
    gmsh.write(str(run / "mesh.msh"))"},{"old":"            "method": "Independent quadratic tetrahedral meshes; surface-consistent nodal traction integrated with seven-point triangle quadrature.",","new":"            "method": "Independent straight-sided quadratic tetrahedral meshes with 28 elements per full circle for curvature sizing; positive Jacobians checked before export. Surface-consistent nodal traction integrated with seven-point triangle quadrature and normalized to the specified total force.","}],"reason":"CalculiX failed because CAD projection of quadratic midside nodes inverted three tetrahedra, as confirmed by both mesher and solver logs. Straight-edge midside placement retains genuine C3D10 quadratic FEM while preventing projection-induced inversion. Increased curvature resolution reduces geometric approximation error; explicit Jacobian validation precedes export, and the existing two-mesh refinement study remains intact."}
